fields.description:
Automatically create missing directories when syncing files
Useful when wiki edits create new file paths
fields.label: Create Missing Folders

fields.description:
Automatically publish wiki pages when created from markdown
Uncheck to create draft pages that need manual publishing
fields.label: Auto Publish Pages

fields.description:
Name of the wiki space folder
Example: docs, user-guide, api-reference
fields.label: Wiki Space Name

fields.description:
Local folder path where markdown files are stored
Example: apps/my_app/docs/docs
Example: apps/crm/docs/crm-docs
fields.label: Docs Folder Path

fields.description:
URL prefix for wiki pages
Example: docs (creates routes like /docs/getting-started)
Example: user-guide (creates routes like /user-guide/configuration)
fields.label: Wiki Route Prefix

fields.description:
Path where uploaded images/files are stored
Example: apps/my_app/public/docs/images
Example: apps/crm/public/assets/wiki-images
fields.label: File Upload Path

fields.description:
Public URL path for accessing uploaded files
Example: /assets/my_app/docs (images accessible at /assets/my_app/docs/images/file.jpg)
Example: /assets/crm/wiki (images accessible at /assets/crm/wiki/images/file.jpg)
fields.label: Public Assets Path

fields.description:
Create folder hierarchy in wiki sidebar using groups from _config.json
Example: Groups 'Basics' and 'Advanced' become sidebar folders
fields.label: Use Parent Label Folders

fields.description:
Run wiki sync automatically during 'bench migrate'
Syncs markdown files to wiki pages after app updates
fields.label: Sync On Migrate

fields.description:
Auto-sync changes from wiki pages back to markdown files
Bi-directional sync: wiki edits update source markdown files
fields.label: Sync On Wiki Update
